decisions.reason: Product A builds on the firm's established offer, so the firm can use its related knowledge to interpret early results and improve it.
Product B builds on the firm's established offer, enabling learning and improvement through existing absorptive capacity.
Product C builds on the firm's established offer, allowing the firm to assimilate information and refine the product.
Product D builds on the firm's established offer, so the firm can draw on related knowledge to evaluate and improve it.
Product E is distant from the firm's established offer and shows an early problem signal, making it difficult for the firm to interpret and learn from results despite its own R&D.
